knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic territory snapshot
knowledge.detail: Four fictional metros with addressable spend, revenue, recruiters and clients by service line.

knowledge.name: Synthetic competitor and labor data
knowledge.detail: Fictional competitor shares by metro and posting, wage and time-to-fill trends by line.

knowledge.name: Planning rules and guardrails
knowledge.detail: Coverage-gap rule, draft-only plan status and the no-headcount, no-quota, no-CRM-change boundary.

intelligence_processing.name: Territory roll-up
intelligence_processing.detail: Totals spend, revenue, share, recruiters and spend per recruiter for each metro and the territory.

intelligence_processing.name: Market sizing
intelligence_processing.detail: Breaks addressable and open spend down by service line for the territory or one metro.

intelligence_processing.name: Coverage-gap detection
intelligence_processing.detail: Flags lines with at least $9.0M spend and under 5% share, ranked by open spend.

intelligence_processing.name: Competitive ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks our share against three fictional competitors in every metro.

intelligence_processing.name: Labor trend reading
intelligence_processing.detail: Turns posting, wage and time-to-fill movement into a planning implication.

intelligence_processing.name: Draft plan synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines gaps, risks and trends into opportunities, recommendations and one priority action.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with six skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives sales leaders a planning conversation once approved controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file StaffingTerritoryPlanningAgent locally with deterministic operations.

management_reporting.name: Territory review tables
management_reporting.detail: Metro and service-line tables with share, open spend and spend per recruiter.

management_reporting.name: Draft quarterly plan
management_reporting.detail: Opportunities, risks, recommendations and a priority action, clearly marked as a draft.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Six passing persona cases, package integrity and the unpublished Draft state.

tools.name: Portable StaffingTerritoryPlanningAgent tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only planning operations.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server that discovers the agent and exposes chat, health and tool routing.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; publishing requires explicit approval.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: User surfaces for approved deployments; the package changes no records.

tools.name: Approved CRM and placement data
tools.detail: Production seam for account and placement history; not connected in the demonstration.

tools.name: Approved labor-market feed
tools.detail: Production seam for posting and wage trends; the demonstration uses fixed synthetic values.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only the bundled fictional territory data and forbids browsing or outside market data.

supporting_features.name: Fictional market entities
supporting_features.detail: Metros and competitors are invented so no real company or market is profiled.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never changes headcount, quotas, account assignments, requisitions or CRM records.

supporting_features.name: Leadership decision gate
supporting_features.detail: The plan is a draft; every recommendation is a decision for sales leadership.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic arithmetic
supporting_features.detail: Shares, open spend and rankings are computed from the same fixed figures every time.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona cases verify one operation each with exact evidence anchors.
